baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins saying at word 3, the Lord-God predicate at words 4-5, and then standing straight at word 7 before the paired negation of fear and grief.
baseline_models.mechanism: A voiced claim becomes an adopted allegiance, and the delayed sequel tests that allegiance as resolved, balanced conduct. The affective promise attaches to the continuity between conviction and posture, not to sound alone.

activation_trace.role: Extends saying into an adopted conviction, allowing the sequel to enact what was voiced.
Supplies ownership and governing authority as the relation asserted by the declaration.
Concentrates worship in the named God and makes the allegiance exclusive rather than generic.
Adds resolve and rising to an undertaking, turning profession into undertaken action.
Supplies straightness and balance as the maintained shape of the declared allegiance.

changed_reading.before: They utter a creed and are then reassured.
changed_reading.after: They adopt exclusive allegiance and carry it into resolved, balanced conduct; the reassurance belongs to enacted continuity between word and stance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive Lord at word 4 is answered by the form of standing at word 7, so the relation can be read dynamically from cultivation to upkeep.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship can supply gradual repair, completion, and growth, while the human response supplies guardianship and the support by which a life remains ordered. Constancy is therefore cultivated maintenance, not a frozen moral pose.

activation_trace.role: Frames lordship as gradual repair, upbringing, and completion rather than title alone.
The packet's growth target adds nourishment and development as an exploratory dimension of lordship.
Adds active care, preservation, and oversight as the work of remaining aligned.
Treats the stance as a supporting order by which life and subsistence hold together.

changed_reading.before: Lord is a sovereign title and straightness is an individual's fixed virtue.
changed_reading.after: The Lord cultivates and completes, while the people answer by tending and sustaining the order grown in them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: After the temporally extended standing at word 7, fear at word 9 and grief at word 13 are separately negated.
baseline_models.mechanism: Straightness supplies a durable orientation. Fear names anticipated harm, while grief roughens the inner state around loss; the promise stabilizes both what lies ahead and what remains within from what has occurred.

activation_trace.role: Adds abiding in a position, giving the sequence temporal duration rather than an instant posture.
Makes balanced orientation the stabilizing center between the two affective negations.
Locates fear in expectation of a signaled harm and supplies the forward-looking horizon.
Locates grief as inward roughness under gloom and supplies the lingering affective horizon.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives a general promise of emotional happiness.
changed_reading.after: Durable alignment settles two different horizons: expectation of coming harm and the inward aftertexture of loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The confirming truth before the focus and the work, recompense, and permanence immediately after it turn the declaration-to-standing sequence into a test of correspondence. The word is true in this reading when conduct carries it forward and the resulting order endures.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the conviction whose truth is tested beyond the moment of utterance.
Makes balanced conduct the form in which the conviction remains true.
Adds truth as realization in promise and act, linking verbal confirmation to performed correspondence.
Names intentional work as the concrete continuation of the focus stance.
Supplies a matched consequence, making the outcome answer the enacted declaration.
Extends the mechanism into durable remaining, answering the duration implicit in standing firm.

structural_cues: The 46:12 to 46:14 sequence moves from confirmation and good-doing, through declaration and constancy, to enduring recompense for work.
The particle translated as then leaves room between profession and the demonstrated posture that follows it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confirmation, declaration, work, matched recompense, and permanence; I supply the arrow that conduct verifies the word; a live alternative is a simple sequence of belief and reward without a special correspondence test.

changed_reading.before: Straightness is an additional virtue listed after a true statement.
changed_reading.after: Straightness is how the statement becomes true in lived form, with deed and durable outcome corresponding to the declared allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next human portrait moves through hidden carrying, repeated arrival at maturity, a renewed address to the Lord, gratitude, work, and repair. It revises cultivated constancy into a life-course response that is received, matured, practiced, and extended into relational repair.

activation_trace.role: Supplies gradual upbringing and completion as the governing relation of the focus claim.
Makes constancy active upkeep that can extend beyond the isolated self.
Supplies concealed carrying and fruit as the earliest stage of a slowly formed life.
Marks repeated arrival at life thresholds, giving cultivation measurable stages.
Revoices the focus act of saying at maturity, now as a direct address shaped by a lived history.
The packet's growth target makes the renewed Lord-address resonate with nourishment and maturation.
Turns received benefit into acknowledged response rather than passive possession.
Adds repair against corruption as the practical and relational shape of maintained alignment.

structural_cues: 46:15 follows the focus with pregnancy, birth, maturation, renewed speech, good work, and concern for descendants.
The later speaker repeats the saying-plus-Lord pattern but unfolds its consequences across a whole life and family relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies life stages, renewed Lord-address, gratitude, work, and repair; I supply the arrow that this portrait instantiates cultivated constancy; a live alternative is that 46:15 is only a separate example of filial duty.

changed_reading.before: Constancy is a private stance achieved after a declaration.
changed_reading.after: Constancy is cultivated through life stages and becomes gratitude, useful work, and repair that reaches beyond the speaker.

context_deltas.mechanism: A mapped side branch at the mature speaker's turning supplies readiness and continuation, while the later degrees supply movement by stages. Together they make a live alternative in which constancy is recoverable orientation and continued advance, not a claim of never having deviated.

activation_trace.role: Provides the straight and balanced orientation that can be maintained or restored.
The packet's side target contributes readiness, continuation, and straightening to the act of turning back.
Adds advance one stage at a time, resisting an all-or-nothing model of the stance.

structural_cues: The mature prayer includes explicit turning, and 46:19 assigns differentiated degrees according to work.
Both cues occur after the focus promise rather than before its declaration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turning, a side branch of continuation, and graded advance; I supply the arrow from return to restored constancy; a live alternative keeps repentance categorically separate from the straightness named in the focus.

changed_reading.before: Standing straight implies an uninterrupted record of moral perfection.
changed_reading.after: Standing straight can name a durable orientation that is restored by turning back and advanced degree by degree.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later warning openly voices fear of expected harm, while the answering scene joins response and settled belief to protective refuge. The focus promise can therefore be read as fear processed through warning and response, not as refusal to register danger.

activation_trace.role: Defines the promised absence against anticipated harm rather than undifferentiated discomfort.
Makes warning an alarm that awakens caution and can redirect behavior before harm arrives.
Places expected harm in a warning voice, showing that acknowledged fear can precede security.
Supplies an actual answer to the call as the behavioral hinge of the conversion.
Adds trusting assent that settles in the heart rather than remaining a startled reaction.
Contributes refuge under protective adjacency as the concrete endpoint of heeded warning.

structural_cues: 46:21 pairs warning with expressed fear, whereas 46:31 pairs answering and believing with protection from the threatened pain.
The focus negation sits conceptually between alert and refuge rather than requiring ignorance of danger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, expressed fear, answering belief, and refuge; I supply the arrow that heeded alarm is converted into non-fear; a live alternative is that the scenes merely contrast two groups without describing a causal process.

changed_reading.before: No fear means that steadfast people simply do not experience alarm.
changed_reading.after: No fear is the secured endpoint of taking warning seriously, answering it, and entering refuge before anticipated harm arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The jinn scene forms a communication circuit: receptive hearing and attentive silence become a turn toward others, voiced report, guidance to an extended route, and a requested answer. The focus speakers can thus be read as participants in a relay whose constancy is both reception and transmission.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in audible speech that can enter a chain of communication.
Supplies the aligned posture that the received message is to produce.
Turns hearing into understanding and compliance, making reception active.
Adds listening silence as the disciplined precondition of later speech.
Marks the moment receptive attention becomes a voiced communal instruction.
Contributes a turn of orientation toward the people who will receive the warning.
Supplies gentle direction to truth and route as the content of the relay.
Makes straightness traversable as an extended route rather than only an internal quality.
Completes the circuit with a demanded reply that can become the next declaration.

structural_cues: 46:29 to 46:31 orders attentive silence, completed hearing, a turn to the community, report, guidance, and response.
The focus order of saying followed by standing is retained, but the later scene reveals prior listening and subsequent relay around it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered communication circuit and a straight route; I supply the arrow that the focus speakers occupy this relay; a live alternative is that the jinn episode illustrates guidance without redefining the earlier declaration.

changed_reading.before: Those who say are isolated confessors whose stance concerns themselves.
changed_reading.after: Those who say are receptive relays: they listen into understanding, voice what they received, orient others, and keep to the route they transmit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the close, saying and Lord-language recur only after truth is presented in punishment, and the next speech commands experience of what denial concealed. This reverse sequence distinguishes the focus declaration by its timely conviction and sustained alignment, not by its vocabulary alone.

activation_trace.role: Makes the focus saying an adopted conviction rather than a merely compelled vocal response.
Anchors the comparison in acknowledged governing lordship.
Supplies the enacted alignment absent from the delayed oath scene.
Frames the late speech against a prior covering of recognized truth.
Places voiced responses around the delayed Lord-oath and the command that follows it.
Repeats acknowledged lordship when denial can no longer be maintained.
Turns abstract denial into compelled experience, reversing the focus movement from conviction to security.

structural_cues: In 46:13, declaration precedes constancy and no fear; in 46:34, a Lord-oath follows presentation to the fire and precedes commanded experience.
The repeated saying and Lord roots sit in opposite temporal and consequential orders.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated roots and opposite sequels; I supply the arrow that timing and enactment discriminate the two confessions; a live alternative treats the late oath as an independent admission with no designed echo of 46:13.

changed_reading.before: The salvific distinction lies in pronouncing the right Lord-language.
changed_reading.after: The distinction lies in timely, adopted allegiance carried into constancy; the same Lord-language uttered only under compelled exposure does not produce the focus promise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing imperative binds the self against panic, names resolute persistence along a route, forbids acceleration, and compresses apparent waiting at the horizon. It retrospectively expands standing straight into paced endurance under delayed fulfillment.

activation_trace.role: Supplies resolve and rising to the task as the active core of the stance.
Keeps the endurance oriented and balanced rather than merely immobile.
Adds restraint of panic as the affective labor required by duration.
Supplies persistent intention and continued movement along a route.
Its negated acceleration prevents constancy from being confused with forcing the promised timetable.
Adds experienced waiting in place, which the final horizon radically compresses.

structural_cues: The surah closes by pairing patience with resolute messengers and by prohibiting haste toward the promised outcome.
The closing time comparison supplies an endpoint from which prolonged waiting appears brief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, resolve, no haste, and compressed waiting; I supply the arrow that the close retrospectively defines focus constancy as paced endurance; a live alternative restricts the closing command to the messenger without extending it to the focus group.

changed_reading.before: Standing straight is immediate correctness after speaking.
changed_reading.after: Standing straight is paced, resolute endurance that restrains panic and refuses to force the timing of fulfillment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a secondary diminution sense and a split-root cutting image rather than the ordinary affective senses. It remains anchored in both negated focus roots and is sharpened by full settlement and non-withholding in 46:19. Downstream prose should carry it only as an accounting and material resonance, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated fear at word 9 can activate taking-away, while the negated grief root at word 13 has a packet-supplied split target of cutting and leaving a mark.

activation_trace.role: Lets negated fear carry a secondary image of no attrition or taking-away.
Lets the split target add a cut or scored mark that the negation refuses.
Supplies complete payment without deficiency, giving the no-attrition reading a contextual counterweight.
Adds non-withholding of a due right to the full-settlement mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The ending promises only relief from two emotions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also promises an outcome from which nothing due is shaved away and in which no cutting mark remains.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading crosses from affect into terrain and route geometry, so it is too material to present as the ordinary sense of grief. It remains valid as an activation because the focus inventory itself supplies rough ground, and the context adds curved dunes, a flood-course, guidance, and an extended path. Render it as a spatial analogy for the stance and its promised passage.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Standing straight at word 7 and the rough-ground branch of grief at word 13 form a direct alignment-versus-terrain contrast inside the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Supplies an upright, even line as the traveler's orienting geometry.
Materializes grief as elevated rough ground, making the negation spatially active.
Adds a curved sand formation as the context's named landscape of deviation.
Supplies a channel traversed by flow, connecting terrain to directed passage.
Adds gentle direction toward truth and route through the difficult landscape.
Provides the extended path on which focus straightness can be imagined as motion.

changed_reading.before: No grief is purely an inward emotional state.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial activation, aligned people are given a directed passage through a landscape of curvature and roughness rather than left to wander its contours.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from the saying root to a carrying-and-rising branch. It remains anchored to the focus saying and standing roots, and 46:15 adds actual carrying under hardship. Render it as a load-bearing metaphor for commitment, never as the direct lexical value of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps saying at word 3 to a side branch of carrying and rising, immediately followed in the focus construction by standing at word 7.

activation_trace.role: Turns the declaration into something taken up and borne before one rises with it.
Completes the material sequence with resolve and rising to the undertaken burden.
Provides contextual carrying from within, making the commitment image developmental rather than merely heavy.
Adds hardship borne with the load, preserving cost inside the image of rising.

changed_reading.before: Saying is a weightless verbal event followed by an unrelated posture.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, saying takes up a commitment as a load, and standing is the act of rising into and bearing what was declared.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The focus branch is an odd anatomical side image, not the normal sense of standing straight. It remains valuable because 46:26 explicitly presents hearing, sight, and hearts that fail to benefit their holders under knowing denial. Downstream prose should use it only as a negative diagnostic boundary: outward intactness is not sufficient constancy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The standing root at word 7 includes a packet branch for an eye whose visible globe remains intact after sight is gone.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the counterimage of an outwardly intact standing form emptied of perception.
Defines useful hearing as understanding and compliance, exposing mere possession of the faculty as insufficient.
Makes actual seeing the missing function behind the focus branch's intact exterior.
Adds inward apprehension to hearing and sight, preventing constancy from collapsing into visible posture.
Supplies knowing denial as the mechanism that leaves available faculties functionally barren.

changed_reading.before: Any outwardly stable posture can count as standing straight.
changed_reading.after: A stance that looks intact while hearing, sight, and inward apprehension are refused is a hollow counterimage, not the constancy promised in the focus.

strongest_changes: The declaration becomes true as deed: saying, balanced conduct, work, matched recompense, and permanence form one correspondence mechanism.
The adjacent life-course scene revises constancy into cultivated maturation, gratitude, useful work, and relational repair.
The late Lord-oath reverses the focus sequence and shows that timely conviction plus enacted alignment, not vocabulary alone, distinguishes the promised speakers.
Warning, answering belief, and refuge make non-fear the result of processing danger rather than ignoring it.
The closing patience sequence expands standing straight into paced endurance that refuses to force fulfillment.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly re-enacted the focus's saying, Lord, and straightness pattern in different mechanisms: verification by work, maturation across a life, warning converted into refuge, attentive listening relayed as a path, and a delayed confession with the opposite outcome. Split targets also preserved live material counterreadings of load, attrition, terrain, and outwardly intact blindness.
remaining_uncertainties: The repeated saying and Lord roots in 46:34 may be a designed reversal or only common vocabulary sharpened by proximity.
The return-as-restored-constancy model depends on a non-dominant mapped branch and should remain exploratory.
The terrain, load, cutting, and blind-eye readings are traceable activations but should not displace the ordinary syntactic and affective readings.
The causal arrow from heeded warning to non-fear is reader-supplied; the packet also permits a simpler contrast between responsive and unresponsive groups.
